# Software HEVC 4:4:4 fixture

Generated by this project's `HiveDeskSoftwareFixture` from synthetic pixels;
contains no captured desktop, personal data or third-party media.

24 low-delay HEVC 8-bit 4:4:4 access units: 12 at 256x256, then 12 at 384x384.
Alternating one-pixel red/blue columns preserve independently testable chroma;
the green channel advances on each frame. Each group has IDRs at offsets 0 and
8 and P-picture references otherwise. The CPU-only test checks exact picture
order, color/chroma, dimensions, seeking to an IDR and damaged input rejection.

Each record is five little-endian uint32 values (width, height, sequence,
keyframe, payload length), followed by the HEVC access unit. Regeneration needs
an NVIDIA GPU with HEVC 4:4:4 encoding, but running the test does not:

```powershell
& .\build\HiveDeskSoftwareFixture.exe tests\fixtures\software-hevc444.bin
& .\build\HiveDeskSoftwareCheck.exe tests\fixtures\software-hevc444.bin
```
